environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in a public subnet with internet gateway attached. The task has an ENI with a public IP and default route (0.0.0.0/0 -> igw). SQS queue policy allows sqs:SendMessage from the application's IAM role. The OAuth token endpoint (auth.internal.corp) resolves via Route53 private hosted zone but the outbound redirect_uri call goes through the NAT/IGW to the public internet. No egress filtering is applied.

config.dns_resolution: Route53 private hosted zone for auth.internal.corp
